units.la: Spiritus servitutis Judæis datus qualis fuerit? I.475.b.
units.tr: Spirit of bondage given to the Jews: what was it like? I. 475b.

units.la: Spiritus promissionis donatio bonum est Nov. Testam. II.174.a,ejus diversa œconomia in V.& N.Test.m. ibid. b.
units.tr: Spirit of promise: the gift is a good of the New Testament, II. 174a; its diverse economy in the Old and New Testaments, ibid. b.

units.la: Spiritus vivificans quomodo & cur Christus dicatur? II. 739.b.
units.tr: Spirit who gives life: how and why is Christ so called? II. 739b.

units.la: Spiritum soporis quomodo immittat Deus? I.274.b.
units.tr: Spirit of sleep: how does God send it? I. 274b.

units.la: Spirituum productio Numen proclamat,I.65.a.
units.tr: Production of spirits proclaims the Deity, I. 65a.

units.la: Spiritualiter mortui quinam sint? II.221. b.
units.tr: Spiritually dead: who are they? II. 221b.

units.la: Spolia Ægyptiaca Israelitarum ad furtum referenda non fuut,I.610,a.
units.tr: Egyptian spoils of the Israelites are not to be reckoned as theft, I. 610a.

units.la: Sponsionem pro electis quando Christus in se suscepe-rit? I.376.a.b.suscepectam deserere non potuit,377. a. qualis fuerit? 378.b. ejus ratio formalis explicatur, & contra Socinianos asseritur,379.b. 380. vid. Brev. Sponsio & obedientia Christi meriti rationem habuit,382. b. Salutis certitudinem confirmat, 389.a. non ad omnes homines sese extendit,391.a.
units.tr: Suretyship for the elect: when did Christ undertake it in himself? I. 376a, b. He could not abandon the undertaking, 377a. What kind of undertaking was it? 378b. Its formal reason is explained and asserted against the Socinians, 379b, 380; see Brev. The suretyship and obedience of Christ had the nature of merit, 382b. It confirms the certainty of salvation, 389a. It does not extend to all men, 391a.

units.la: Sponsalia. eorum leges apud Hebræos,I.718.a. & ritus desponsatam deducendi, ibid.b.
units.tr: Betrothals: their laws among the Hebrews, I. 718a, and the rites for leading the betrothed home, ibid. b.

units.la: Sponsoris Justitia quomodo nostra fiat ?I.274.b.
units.tr: Surety's righteousness: how does it become ours? I. 274b.

units.la: Spontaneitas, τὸ ἑκούσιον quid sit?I.330.b.
units.tr: Spontaneity, τὸ ἑκούσιον [τὸ ἑκούσιον]: what is it? I. 330b.

units.la: Spurii,exposititii, hæreticorum infantes an baptizandi ?II.452.a.
units.tr: Spurious, foundlings, children of heretics: are they to be baptized? II. 452a.

units.la: Stancari error de Mediatore Christo tantùm secundum Naturam humanam,I I.81.a.confutatur,82,a.
units.tr: Stancar's error, that Christ the Mediator is only according to his human nature, I. 81a, is refuted, 82a.

units.la: Stapletoni distinctio inter electionem ad gratiam & ad gloriam elicitur,I.164.a.
units.tr: Stapleton's distinction between election to grace and election to glory is drawn out, I. 164a.

units.la: Statuas religiosas Lex erigi vetat, I.721.a.
units.tr: Religious statues: the Law forbids them to be erected, I. 721a.

units.la: Status primi hominis in puris naturalibus confutatur, I.225.a.,duplex hominis status,vel corruptæ naturæ & peccati, vel conversionis & gratiæ,II.218.a.
units.tr: Status of the first man in pure nature is refuted, I. 225a. The twofold status of man: either of corrupt nature and sin, or of conversion and grace, II. 218a.

units.la: Status Christi exinanitionis definitur, II.36.a. in ejus Nativitate cœpit,ib.b. in eo,quòd formâ servi assumtâ legi subjectus fuit, consistit, 37. a. & quòd Sponsor,Mediator fuit 37. b.
units.tr: State of Christ's humiliation is defined, II. 36a. It began at his Nativity, ib. b. It consists in his being subject to the law after taking the form of a servant, 37a, and in his being Surety and Mediator, 37b.

units.la: Statuta Legis qualia præcepta notent ? I.647.a.
units.tr: Statutes of the Law: what precepts do they denote? I. 647a.

units.la: Staurolatria Pontificiorum, I. 538.b.
units.tr: Staurolatry of the Papists, I. 538b.

units.la: Stellarum creatio ex primæva luce, I.208. b. illa Magorum in Nativ. Christi qualis fuerit? 210.b.
units.tr: Stars: their creation from the primal light, I. 208b. What was that star of the Magi at Christ's nativity like? 210b.

units.la: Stephani proto-Martyris, de Legislatione Mosaica testimonium,I.456.a.
units.tr: Stephen, the first martyr: his testimony concerning the Mosaic legislation, I. 456a.

units.la: Stipendia Ecclesiæ Ministris debentur,I I.575. a. Anabaptistarum atgumenta refelluntur, ibid. b. modus, quo Ministris de sustentatione providendum est, exponitur, 576. b. nec tenuia, nec lauta nimis esse debent, 577.a. etiam ea, quæ Sacrificulis dabantur, iis destinari possunt, 578.
units.tr: Stipends are owed to the ministers of the Church, II. 575a. The arguments of the Anabaptists are refuted, ibid. b. The manner in which provision is to be made for the ministers' support is set out, 576b. They ought to be neither meagre nor too lavish, 577a. Even those things which were given to sacrificing priests may be assigned to them, 578.

units.la: Stipulatio & astipulatio in fœdere Dei cum homine quid sit ? I.304.a. in fœdere gratiæ est fidei & resipiscentiæ 384. a.
units.tr: Stipulation and co-stipulation in God's covenant with man: what is it? I. 304a. In the covenant of grace it consists of faith and repentance, 384a.

units.la: Stoicorum universum mundum Dei nomine vendicantium sententia refellitur,I. 106.b. Stoica ἐκπύρωσις damnatur, 342. b. conflagrationem mundi statuerunt.II.752.a.
units.tr: The opinion of the Stoics, who claimed the whole universe in the name of God, is refuted, I. 106b. The Stoic ecpyrosis [ἐκπύρωσις] is condemned, 342b. They held to a conflagration of the world, II. 752a.

units.la: Strangulatio quibus criminibus adhibita fuerit ? I. 711. b. quomodo fieri solita? 712. a.
units.tr: Strangling: for what crimes was it employed? I. 711b. How was it usually carried out? 712a.

units.la: Stuprum quid ? I. 597.b.violentum seu raptus,598.a.
units.tr: Fornication: what is it? I. 597b; violent, or rape, 598a.

units.la: Stylus Theologiæ,qualis esse debeat ? I.18. b. humano quatenus uti liceat ?ibid.119. a. Ethnici styli abusus imaginum cultum invexit,537.b.
units.tr: Style of theology: what should it be like? I. 18b. How far may human style be used? ibid. 119a. The abuse of the pagan style introduced the worship of images, I. 537b.

units.la: Suasiones & minæ non requirunt liberum hominis arbitrium, I. 368.a. Suasio moralis ad bonum quid? 561. b.
units.tr: Persuasions and threats do not require the free will of man, I. 368a. What is moral persuasion towards good? 561b.

units.la: Subditi. eorum erga superiores fidelitas,I.568.a. Magistratûs legibus obedire tenentur, I I.623. a. quatenus,ibid. b.
units.tr: Subjects: their fidelity towards their superiors, I. 568a. They are bound to obey the laws of the magistrate, II. 623a; in what respects, ibid. b.

units.la: Subjectio Uxoris qualis esse debeat? I.570. a. Subjectione inferior quomodo quis dicatur? II.643. b. 644. a.
units.tr: Subjection of the wife: what should it be like? I. 570a. In what sense is someone said to be inferior in subjection? II. 643b, 644a.

units.la: Sublimitas Doctrinæ S.Scripturæ, ejus Divinitatem evincit,I.27.a.
units.tr: Sublimity of the doctrine of Scripture proves its divinity, I. 27a.

units.la: Subordinatio causarum secundarum causæ primæ qualis & quotuplex ? I.267.b.
units.tr: Subordination of secondary causes to the first cause: what sort is it, and how many kinds are there? I. 267b.

units.la: Subsistentia & λόγος quo sensu naturæ Christi humanæ communicata dici possit ? II.128.b.
units.tr: Subsistence and [λόγος]: in what sense can it be said to be communicated to the human nature of Christ? II. 128b.

units.la: Successio Episcoporum ab Apostolis usque in Ecclesia Romana sine interruptione continuata non est veræ Ecclesiæ nota,I I.547.a. vel in corpus vel in caput est,574.a.
units.tr: Succession of bishops from the Apostles, continued without interruption in the Roman Church, is not a mark of the true Church, I. 547a; whether it is in the body or in the head, 574a.

units.la: Successio in bona defuncti qualis obtinuerit apud Hebræos, I. 729. a. Patris & à latere ubi locum habuerit? 730,a. fratris fratriam ducentis,in bona defuncti fratris,730.b. Filii in bona defunctorum, ib. talis successio in bona defunctorum semper certa fuit,731.
units.tr: Succession to the goods of the deceased: what kind obtained among the Hebrews? I. 729a. Of father, and from the side: where did it take place? 730a. Of a brother, where a brother's daughter is taken in marriage, to the goods of the deceased brother, 730b. Of sons, to the goods of the deceased, ib. Such succession to the goods of the deceased was always certain, 731.

units.la: Sudor Christi sanguineus non fuit naturalis,I I.44.b.
units.tr: Christ's bloody sweat was not natural, II. 44b.

units.la: Suetonius falsò Christum seditiosum dixit,II.150.a.
units.tr: Suetonius falsely called Christ a seditious man, II. 150a.

units.la: Suffius adumbravit meritum Christi,I.675.a.
units.tr: Incense foreshadowed the merit of Christ, I. 675a.

units.la: Suffimenta, qualia fuerint, I.653.b. efficaciam & consummationem sacrificii Christi adumbrarunt,675.a.
units.tr: Fumigations: what kinds were they? I. 653b. They foreshadowed the efficacy and fulfilment of Christ's sacrifice, 675a.

units.la: Sui defensio, quatenus licita sit ? I.583. b. aliena, 586. b.
units.tr: Self-defence: how far is it lawful? I. 583b; defence of another, 586b.

units.la: Summum bonum quid ? II. 771. b. 773. seq. vid. Visio Dei.
units.tr: Highest good: what is it? II. 771b, 773 ff.; see Vision of God.

units.la: Superbia malorum Angelorum primum peccatum, I. 286.b. Superbia quid ? 521.b. 565.b.
units.tr: Pride of the evil angels was the first sin, I. 286b. What is pride? 521b, 565b.

units.la: Superiorum & inferiorum mutua officia, I, 566. b. inferiorum,567.superiorum,569.b.
units.tr: Mutual duties of superiors and inferiors: I. 566b; of inferiors, 567; of superiors, 569b.

units.la: Superius aut Inferius quo respectu aliquid dicatur ? II. 643.b.
units.tr: In what respect is something called superior or inferior? II. 643b.

units.la: Superstitio quid? I.521. b.
units.tr: Superstition: what is it? I. 521b.

units.la: Supplicium genera apud Hebræos,I.711.b.
units.tr: Punishments: the kinds among the Hebrews, I. 711b.

units.la: Supralapsarii respondetur,I.160 b.
units.tr: Supralapsarians: answered, I. 160b.

units.la: Suscepto-res in Baptismo unde orti ? II.459. b.eorum ministerium utile est; sed abusibus non caret,460.a.
units.tr: Sponsors in Baptism: whence did they arise? II. 459b. Their ministry is useful, but it is not free from abuses, 460a.

units.la: Suspendii supplicium apud Hebræos execrabile fuit, I. 1.712. a.
units.tr: The punishment of hanging was abhorrent among the Hebrews, I. 712a.

units.la: Syllogismus Practicus de salute & fide,I I.421.a.423.b.
units.tr: The practical syllogism concerning salvation and faith, II. 421a, 423b.

units.la: Symbolum Athanasianum. S.S. Trinitatis mysterium rite pandit,I.111. b.
units.tr: The Athanasian Creed duly unfolds the mystery of the Holy Trinity, I. 111b.

units.la: Symbolorum in S. Cœna mystica significatio explicatur,
units.tr: Symbols in the mystical Supper: the significance of them is explained, II.

units.la: catur, 1I 476.
units.tr: ...is explained, II. 476.

units.la: Syncretistæ Reformatos inter & Pontificios,I.313.b.
units.tr: Syncretists between the Reformed and the Papists, I. 313b.

units.la: Synecdoche in præceptis Decalogi observanda est, I. 314.a. in locutionibus Sacramentalibus,398.b.
units.tr: Synecdoche is to be observed in the precepts of the Decalogue, I. 314a; in sacramental expressions, 398b.

units.la: Synedria Hebræorum qualia fuerint? I. 709. a. magnum duravit usque ad Christum, ibid. b. minora viginti,708.a.
units.tr: Synods of the Hebrews: what were they like? I. 709a. The great synod lasted down to Christ, ibid. b. The lesser ones of twenty members, 708a.

units.la: Συνείδησις Θεῶ conscientia Dei quid?I.8.a.
units.tr: Conscience toward God [συνείδησις θεοῦ]: what is it? I.8.a.

units.la: Συγκατάβασις in sermone, adulationis species non est, I. 631. b.
units.tr: Condescension [συγκατάβασις] in speech is not a kind of flattery. I.631.b.

units.la: Synods. earum institutum utile est,II. 613. vindicantur contra Independentes, 614.a. controversiæ quomodo in iis decidendæ? ibid. b. à Magistratu convocandæ sunt,633,a.
units.tr: Synods: their institution is useful. II.613. They are defended against the Independents, 614.a. How are controversies to be decided in them? Ibid. b. They are to be convened by the magistrate, 633.a.

units.la: T.
units.tr: T.

units.la: Tabernaculorum festum quale?I.665. b. quale Mysterium habuerit? 682. b.
units.tr: Feast of Tabernacles: what kind of feast was it? I.665.b. What mystery did it have? 682.b.

units.la: Tabernaculum. eius partes distinguuntur,I.664.a. ejus & Templi mystica significatio, 679. b.
units.tr: Tabernacle: its parts are distinguished, I.664.a. Its mystical significance and that of the Temple, 679.b.

units.la: Tabulæ illæ, in quibus Deus scripsit Decalogum, quales fuerint? I, 511. a. quot cuivis præcepta assignanda, ibid. b.
units.tr: Tables on which God wrote the Decalogue: what were they like? I.511.a. How many precepts are to be assigned to each table? Ibid. b.

units.la: Taciturnitas quid? I. 635.a.
units.tr: Silence: what is it? I.635.a.

units.la: Talio. ejus pœna apud Hebræos qualis fuerit? I.712.b. ejus lex falso testi decreta,7 8.b.
units.tr: Talion: what was its penalty among the Hebrews? I.712.b. The law decreed against a false witness, 7 8.b.

units.la: Targumim seu Paraphrases V.Test.variæ sunt,I. 50,a.
units.tr: Targumim, or paraphrases of the Old Testament, are various. I.50.a.

units.la: Taurelli error de Providentia Dei,I.251.a.
units.tr: Taurellus: his error concerning the providence of God. I.251.a.

units.la: Templum Hierosolymitanum cultui destinatum fuit, I. 663. seq. prioris structura, posterioris sanctitas explicantur, 664. b. ejus mystica significatio, 680.a.
units.tr: Temple of Jerusalem was destined for worship. I.663 ff. The structure of the former and the holiness of the latter are explained, 664.b. Its mystical significance, 680.a.

units.la: Templa cultui Divino destinata sunt, I. 337. a. locus sunt administrandorum Sacramentorum, II. 473. b. quando exstrui coeperint? 612.a. non sepulturæ destinanda sunt, 699. b.
units.tr: Temples are destined for the worship of God. I.337.a. They are places for administering the sacraments. II.473.b. When did they begin to be built? 612.a. They are not to be appointed for burial, 699.b.

units.la: Templum tertium Ezechieli Cap.XL.XLI. repræsentatum mysticum & spirituale est,I.739. b. an & quomodo sub Messia struendum fuerit? II. 146. a. secundi gloria præ priori in quibus constiterit? 140. b.
units.tr: Temple: the third temple in Ezekiel, chapters 40 and 41, is represented as mystical and spiritual. I.739.b. Whether and how it was to be built under the Messiah. II.146.a. In what did the glory of the second temple over the first consist? 140.b.

units.la: Templum in quo ὁ Ἀνομῶν sedet explicatur,II.524.a.
units.tr: Temple in which the Lawless One sits is explained. II.524.a.

units.la: Tempus quomodo æternitati coexistat? I. 76. b. quid sit? Aristotelis falsa de eo sententia, 194 a.
units.tr: Time: how does it coexist with eternity? I.76.b. What is it? Aristotle's false opinion about it, 194.a.

units.la: Temporum V. & N.Testam.distinctio & differentiæ variæ, I. 419.a.b. tempora cultus Sacri V. Test. distinguuntur, & explicantur, 665. a. Temporum statorum, & quæ in iisdem gerebantur significatio mystica eruitur,682.a.
units.tr: Times of the Old and New Testaments: their distinction and various differences. I.419.a.b. The times of the sacred worship of the Old Testament are distinguished and explained, 665.a. The mystical significance of the fixed times, and of what was done in them, is drawn out, 682.a.

units.la: Tempora gentium qualia sint? II.712.b.
units.tr: Times of the Gentiles: what kind are they? II.712.b.

units.la: Tenebræ priores luce fuerunt,I. 202.b.
units.tr: Darkness was before light. I.202.b.

units.la: Tentatio. Tentationi & dubitationi circa propriam electionem quomodo occurrendum? I. 172.a. 177. Tentatis electionis gratia solatio est,209.a. vel Divina, vel humana,vel Diabolica est,358.a. Tentationes Dei, 372. a. Sathanæ. ibid. Tentationibus labefactatur gratiæ certitudo, II.419. b. nec tamen evertitur, 420. a. Tentatio Christi declaratur, II. 41. b.
units.tr: Temptation. How is one to meet temptation and doubt concerning one's own election? I.172.a. 177. The assurance of election is a consolation in temptation, 209.a. A temptation is either divine, human, or diabolical, 358.a. The temptations of God, 372.a. Of Satan, ibid. The certainty of grace is shaken by temptations, II.419.b. Yet it is not overthrown, 420.a. The temptation of Christ is set forth, II.41.b.

units.la: Terra. ejus creatio,I.201.a. quomodo vasta fuerit?ibid. origo, 206. fundatio super aquis,ib.b. quomodo firmata sit? 207. a. ei germinatio tribuitur,208.a.ejus modus in Scriptura negatur,211. b.
units.tr: Earth: its creation, I.201.a. How was it waste? Ibid. Its origin, 206. Its foundation upon the waters, ibid. b. How was it made firm? 207.a. Germination is ascribed to it, 208.a. Its mode is denied in Scripture, 211.b.

units.la: Terræ bonæ et petrosæ parabola explicatur, II.403. b.
units.tr: Parable of the good and stony ground is explained. II.403.b.

units.la: Testamentum æternum quid? I. 157. b. in quo Filius Dei est primarius hæres, 159.a.
units.tr: Eternal covenant: what is it? I.157.b. In it the Son of God is the principal heir, 159.a.

units.la: Testamentum. Dei quid sit? I. 386. b. Διαθήκη & Συνθήκη quomodo differant? 387.a. Testam.gratiæ ab æterno initum,in tempore per promissionem notificatum est,387.a.irrevocabile est.ib.b.In V.& N.Test. unum est, 408. a.
units.tr: Covenant of God: what is it? I.386.b. How do diathēkē and synthēkē differ? [διαθήκη, συνθήκη] 387.a. The covenant of grace was entered into from eternity, and was made known in time by promise, 387.a. It is irrevocable, ibid. b. In the Old and New Testaments it is one, 408.a.

units.la: Testamentum. Vetus & Novum quomodo differant?I.34. a. Libri Vet. Testam. quot & qui?I 5.a. eorum Canon non Esdræ authoritate constitutus aut restitutus est. ibid. eorum custodia à Deo mandata fuit, I. 35. a. à Judæis non sunt corrupti. ib. b. 36. a. nulli perierunt, ib. 36b. 37. a. eorum usus in Novo Test. non abrogatus est, 38. a. Testamenti utriusque Vet. & Novi essentia eadem,38 •a. Test. Novi librorum recensio, 38.b.scripti ab iis, quorum nomina præfe-runt,39.a.linguâ Græcâ exarati sunt.ibid.de quibusdam frustra dubitatum est, 39.b.nulli perierunt.ib. 40.a. Pseud-epigraphi rejecti,ibid.Testamenti Vet. & Novi bona spiritualia non essentialiter differunt, 410.411.utriusque temporum distinctio & differen-tiæ variæ,419. a.b.
units.tr: Testament: how do the Old and New differ? I.34.a. How many and which are the books of the Old Testament? I.5.a. Their canon was not established or restored by the authority of Ezra, ibid. God commanded their safekeeping, I.35.a. They were not corrupted by the Jews, ibid. b. 36.a. None of them has perished, ibid. b. 36b. 37.a. Their use in the New Testament has not been abrogated, 38.a. The essence of the Old and New Testaments is the same, 38a. The list of the books of the New Testament, 38.b. They were written by those whose names they bear, 39.a. They were composed in the Greek language, ibid. Doubts about some of them have been raised in vain, 39.b. None has perished, ibid. 40.a. The pseudepigrapha are rejected, ibid. The spiritual goods of the Old and New Testaments do not differ in essence, 410, 411. The distinction and various differences of the two times, 419.a.b.

units.la: Testamentum variè distinguitur. I. 471. Vetus quid proprie notet? ib.b.Novum quid? ib. 472. Veteris Characteres,ibid .Mediator ejus,473.a. œconomia explicata,ibid.Testamenti Novi præ Veteri ὑπερέχει, 497.a. a-498.a. Testamentum Novum & melius illud quid sit ?II.156. 157. Veteris antiquatio, 158,a. peculiarem œconomiam habet, 160.b. Veteris & Novi bona qualia?170.b.Novi Test. fidelium bona eximia, 170. 171.172.
units.tr: Testament is variously distinguished. I.471. What does Vetus properly denote? Ibid. b. What does Novum denote? Ibid. 472. The characters of the Old, ibid. Its mediator, 473.a. Its economy is explained, ibid. The New Testament excels the Old, 497.a. to 498.a. The New Testament and what that better covenant is, II.156, 157. The abolition of the Old, 158.a. It has its own peculiar economy, 160.b. What are the goods of the Old and New? 170.b. The excellent goods of believers under the New Testament, 170, 171, 172.

units.la: Testator Christus fuit, I. 379. a.
units.tr: Testator was Christ. I.379.a.

units.la: Testimonium. Humani authoritas ad dijudiandam revelationem Divinam nihil valet,I.9.a.Testis & Testimonium publicum explicatur, 637.b. publicum & privatum explicatur,638.a.
units.tr: Testimony. Human authority counts for nothing in judging the divine revelation. I.9.a. A witness and public testimony are explained, 637.b. Public and private [testimony] are explained, 638.a.

units.la: Testimonium in Dei verbo est Evangelium, I. 108. a. Spiritus S. Testimonium, Scripturam esse Verbum Dei, est efficax, 18. a. infallibile, ibid. b. co ad cognoscendam Scripturæ Divinitatem opus est,28.a. non Ecclesiæ, ib.b. Testimonium Ecclesiæ improbanda Scripturæ Divinitate occasionale , ib.19. a non principale & authenticum est, ibid, vid. Ecclesia.
units.tr: Testimony in the Word of God is the Gospel. I.108.a. The testimony of the Holy Spirit, that Scripture is the Word of God, is effective, 18.a. and infallible, ibid. b. It is needed for knowing the divinity of Scripture, 28.a. It is not the Church's, ibid. b. The testimony of the Church is occasional, not principal and authentic, in confirming the divinity of Scripture, 19.a. ibid. See Church.

units.la: Testimonium Spiritus S. in fidelibus de eorum adoptione testatur, II. 412. a. certum est etiam fidelium respectu, ib. b.
units.tr: Testimony of the Holy Spirit in believers bears witness to their adoption. II.412.a. It is certain also with respect to believers, ibid. b.

units.la: Testis quid? I.637. b. ad Testimonium publicum duo minimum testes requiruntur,ib.
units.tr: Witness: what is it? I.637.b. For public testimony at least two witnesses are required, ibid.

units.la: Testium inidoneorum in jure Hebræo decem fuerunt genera, 711. b. Testi falso legem talionis lex decrevit.718. b.
units.tr: Witnesses: of unfit witnesses in Hebrew law there were ten kinds, 711.b. The law of talion decreed against a false witness, 718.b.

units.la: Testes duo Apocalyptici quinam? I I.540.a 689.b.
units.tr: Two witnesses of the Apocalypse: who are they? I.540.a. 689.b.

units.la: Tetragrammati nominis à Davide Lapidi Templi inscripti fabula confutatur,I I.98. b.
units.tr: Tetragrammaton: the fable that David engraved the name on the stone of the Temple is refuted. II.98.b.

units.la: Textus Sacri in Concionibus ad populum quales esse, quomodo declarari ac tractari debeant,II.596.
units.tr: Sacred texts in sermons to the people: what they should be like, and how they should be declared and handled. II.596.

units.la: Thamux.Ezech.VIII.4. quale idolum fuerit? I.651.a.
units.tr: Thamux, Ezekiel 8.4: what idol was it? I.651.a.

units.la: Thebaus (Paulus) primus fuit Monachus,I I.675.a.
units.tr: Thebaean (Paul) was the first monk. II.675.a.

units.la: Theocratia Populi Israelitici declaratur, I.701. ejus origo & progressus describitur,701. Mysterium ejus eruitur,ib.b.703.ei religio innexa est,703.b.
units.tr: Theocracy of the Israelite people is set forth. I.701. Its origin and progress are described, 701. Its mystery is drawn out, ibid. b. 703. Religion is bound up with it, 703.b.

units.la: Theologia. hujus vocis origo,I.2,a. usus ejusdem in Ecclesiam inductus, ibid. Synonyma ἐπιστήμη, ibid. b. vocis definitio, ib. 3.a. vide Breviar. Theologia Adami integri , ibid. naturalis post lapsum affertur, ibid. Theologiæ revelatæ definitio,5. b. orthodoxæ criteria, ib. 6.a. œconomiæ ejus triplex distinctio,7. a. non tantum est Noëtica,sed etiam Dianoëtica,13.a. ejus unitas,17.b. diversitas, ibid.Systemaricæ descriptio, ib. 18. ejusdem discrimen Scholastica , ibid. cujus historia, origo & erroies narrantur, ibid. Theologiæ stylus qualis esse debeat? ibid.18,b. Mysticæ origo & crisis,ibid.19. a, b. Theologia Practica tota est , 21. a. ejus methodus & loci, 21. b.
units.tr: Theology: the origin of this word, I.2.a. The use of it introduced into the Church, ibid. Synonyms: epistēmē [ἐπιστήμη], ibid. b. Definition of the word, ibid. 3.a. See the Breviary. The theology of Adam in integrity, ibid. Natural theology after the fall is brought forward, ibid. Definition of revealed theology, I.5.b. Criteria of orthodox theology, ibid. 6.a. Its threefold distinction of economy, 7.a. It is not only noetic but also dianoetic, 13.a. Its unity, 17.b. Its diversity, ibid. Description of systematic theology, ibid. 18. Its distinction from scholastic theology, ibid. Its history, origin and errors are told, ibid. What style theology ought to have, ibid. 18.b. The origin and crisis of mystical theology, ibid. 19.a, b. Practical theology is entire, 21.a. Its method and loci, 21.b.

units.la: Theologus. Ejus descriptio, I.5. b. officium explicatur,I I.583.a.
units.tr: Theologian: his description, I.5.b. His office is explained, II.583.a.

units.la: Thesauri Papalis Ecclesiæ vanitas, I I.293.294.
units.tr: Treasury of the Papal Church: its vanity, II.293, 294.

units.la: Thomæ Apostoli incredulitas,I 1.62.b.
units.tr: Thomas the Apostle: his unbelief, I.62.b.

units.la: Thyaneus (Apollonius) insignis magus, cum Christo in cœlum ascendente, à Philostrato impiè contenditur,I I.65. a.
units.tr: Apollonius of Tyana, a notable magician, when Christ ascended into heaven, is impiously pitted against him by Philostratus, II.65.a.

units.la: Tikkun Sopherim non corruptionem aut correctionem Codicis Hebræi arguunt,I.36.b.
units.tr: Tikkun Sopherim do not indicate corruption or correction of the Hebrew codex. I.36.b.

units.la: Tilenus absolutum reprobationis decretum blasphemè traducit,I.178.
units.tr: Tilenus blasphemously misrepresents the absolute decree of reprobation. I.178.

units.la: Timor Dei quid? I.521.a. oppositá ejus,ibid.b. primum Magistratus pii requisitum est, 704. a. in Scriptura mandatus fidei & gratiæ certitudinem non tollit, II. 413. a.
units.tr: Fear of God: what is it? I.521.a. Its opposite, ibid. b. It is the first requirement of a godly magistrate, 704.a. The fear commanded in Scripture does not remove the certainty of faith and grace, II.413.a.

units.la: Timor gehennæ per se non est resipiscentiæ pars ,I. 322. a.
units.tr: Fear of hell is not in itself a part of repentance. I.322.a.

units.la: Titulus Domini de possessione justa testatur,I. 604.a. Tituli Christo in Scriptura tributi certitudinem salutis probant, 390.391.
units.tr: Titles of the Lord attest to a rightful possession. I.604.a. The titles ascribed to Christ in Scripture prove the certainty of salvation, 390, 391.

units.la: Titulares Episcopi unde orti? II.571.a.
units.tr: Titular bishops: whence did they arise? II.571.a.

units.la: Toldos Jeschu blasphemæ contra Christi miracula criminationes,I I.98. a.
units.tr: Toledoth Jeshu: blasphemous charges against the miracles of Christ. II.98.a.

units.la: Toletanum Concilium resurrectionem ejusdem numero corporis docuit,I I.738.a.
units.tr: Council of Toledo taught the resurrection of the same body in number. II.738.a.

units.la: Tonsura Clericorum eos à potestate seculari non eximit,I 1.667.b.
units.tr: Tonsure of clerics does not exempt them from secular power. I.667.b.

units.la: Totos nos Deo,Christo debemus,I I.577.a.
units.tr: We owe everything, the whole of us, to God and to Christ. II.577.a.

units.la: Traditio antiquitas,I.615. b.
units.tr: Tradition: antiquity. I.615.b.

units.la: Traditus Dei in hominis conversione,I.223. b.
units.tr: The drawing of God in the conversion of man. I.223.b.

units.la: Traditio Patriarcharum per Legem scripeam non abolita fuit, I.7. b. vera à falsa distinguitur, ib. 8. b. ab Adamo ad Mosen usque quomo io facta sit? I.23. b. ubi locum habeat? 39.a. Judæorum ceu imperfecta à Christo rejicitur, 41. b. Muhamedanorum & Pontificiorum 42.a. refutantur,ib.42.b. 43.b.
units.tr: Tradition of the patriarchs was not abolished by the written Law. I.7.b. True and false tradition are distinguished, ibid. 8.b. How was it carried on from Adam to Moses? I.23.b. Where does it have its place? I.39.a. Christ rejected the traditions of the Jews as imperfect, I.41.b. The traditions of the Muslims and the Papists are refuted, I.42.a, ibid. 42.b, 43.b.

units.la: Traditiones Judæorum veterum quales? I I.92.a.
units.tr: Traditions of the ancient Jews: what kind were they? II.92.a.

units.la: Traditio Christi in manus gentilium necessaria fuit, I I.46. a.
units.tr: Handing over of Christ into the hands of the Gentiles was necessary. II.46.a.

units.la: Transubstantiatio, ejus dogma hostias numularias in Missam invexit, I I. 463. b. monstrum hoc quando & quomodo in Ecclesiam invectum sit? 481. b. mater est Missæ,quæ refellitur, 482.b. seq.ejus absurditates, 483. a. ejus historia,484. a. a. argumenta pro illa, ibid.b. diluuntur,487.a.
units.tr: Transubstantiation: its dogma introduced wafers (hostiae numulariae) into the Mass. II.463.b. When and how was this monster introduced into the Church? II.481.b. It is the mother of the Mass, which is refuted, II.482.b. ff. Its absurdities, II.483.a. Its history, II.484.a. The arguments for it, ibid. b., are answered, II.487.a.

units.la: Tribunal hominum Justificatorum duplex,I.304.a.
units.tr: Tribunal of justified men, twofold, I.304.a.

units.la: Tributum pendendum Magistratui,I I.I.668.b.
units.tr: Tribute to be paid to the magistrate, II.I.668.b.

units.la: Tributarii Israelitis quinam.& cur sint facti? I.736.a.
units.tr: Who were the tributaries of the Israelites, and why were they made so? I.736.a.

units.la: Tridentini Concilii error versionem vulgatam canonizantium,I.51.b. 52.a. vid. Concilia.
units.tr: The Tridentine Council's error in canonizing the Vulgate version, I.51.b. 52.a. See Councils.

units.la: Triduo quomodo Christus in sepulchro mansit, I I. 57. b. Ambrosii sententia rejicitur,ib.
units.tr: How did Christ remain in the sepulchre for the three days? II.57.b. Ambrose's opinion is rejected, ib.

units.la: S. S. Trinitas. Ejus Mysterium otantia vocabula quali a & quâ cautione adhibenda? I.110. b. ante lapsum protoplastis cognita fuit,113. b. ex cap.I. 1. Genef. probatur, 114.a. ex variis Vet. Test. locis probatur,ib.116.b. Ejus Mysterium in V. Testam. obscurius licet patefactum, tamen clarissimè, 117. b. numerus Personarum numerans, I.Joh.V.7. habetur, generali argumento Personarum Trinitas demonstratur, 118.a. Trinitas Personarum Divinarum quomodo ex Gen.I. 1. demonstretur? 188.b. Trinitatis speculum confutatur, I I. 709. b.
units.tr: Holy Trinity. Its mystery: what terms are to be used for it, and with what caution? I.110.b. It was known before the fall of the first parents, 113.b. It is proved from Gen. 1.1, 114.a. It is proved from various places of the Old Testament, ib. 116.b. Its mystery is revealed more obscurely in the Old Testament, yet very clearly, 117.b. The number of Persons: 1 John 5.7 is found. By a general argument the Trinity of Persons is demonstrated, 118.a. How is the Trinity of the Divine Persons demonstrated from Gen. 1.1? 188.b. The mirror of the Trinity is refuted, II.709.b.

units.la: Tristitia mundi quid? I.311. b. illa secundum Deum salutaris est.323.a. spiritualis quid? 521.b.
units.tr: What is the sorrow of the world? I.311.b. That sorrow, according to God, is salutary, 323.a. What is spiritual sorrow? 521.b.

units.la: Trinum Deum tola Scriptura revelat,I.109.b.
units.tr: Scripture as a whole reveals the triune God, I.109.b.

units.la: Tropus in locutionibus Sacramentalibus ubi sit ? I. 399. b.
units.tr: Where is the trope in sacramental expressions? I.399.b.

units.la: Tρoπoφορεῖ quid significet? I.650..b.
units.tr: What does tropophorei [τροποφορεῖ] signify? I.650.b.

units.la: Tuba. Festi Tubarum signi catio mystica,I. 683. a. ultima illa adventum Christi prænuntians qualis sit? I I. 718. b.
units.tr: The trumpet. The mystical signification of the festival of trumpets, I.683.a. What kind is that last trumpet which announces the coming of Christ? II.718.b.

units.la: Turca finistriam honorificentiorem habent,I I.67. b. eorum de miraculis Christi testimonia ,97. a. cur in Sacris suis lingua Arabica utantur ?434.a.
units.tr: The Turks hold the left hand to be more honourable, II.67.b. Their testimonies concerning the miracles of Christ, 97.a. Why do they use the Arabic language in their sacred rites? 434.a.

units.la: Turpiloquium contagiosum est,I.635.a.
units.tr: Foul speech is contagious, I.635.a.

units.la: Tutelares Angeli sunt Platonicorum genii boni , I. 281. b.
units.tr: Guardian angels are the good genii of the Platonists, I.281.b.

units.la: Tutorum officium,I.616.a.
units.tr: The duty of guardians, I.616.a.

units.la: Tvvisus in sententia de objecto electionis arguitur, I. 160.b. de potestate Dei in creaturas notatur.321. a.
units.tr: Twisse is challenged in his opinion on the object of election, I.160.b; he is criticized on God's power over creatures, 321.a.

units.la: Typi variè distinguuntur, I. 484. b. eorum definitio, 485. eorum dignoscendorum regulæ,485. b. explicandorum , ibid.486. fuerunt umbræ futurorum , 486.a.
units.tr: Types are variously distinguished, I.484.b. Their definition, 485. Rules for recognizing them, 485.b. Rules for explaining them, ibid. 486. They were shadows of things to come, 486.a.

units.la: V.
units.tr: V.

units.la: VAcca rufa quale sacrum piaculare? I.661. a. ejus combustæ cineres & aquæ fœditatis quid significaverint? 691.b.
units.tr: What kind of sacrifice for sin was the red heifer? I.661.a. What did its burnt ashes and the water of impurity signify? 691.b.

units.la: Valentinianorum veterum error de carne Christi refutatur, I I. 14.b.
units.tr: The error of the ancient Valentinians concerning the flesh of Christ is refuted, I I. 14.b.

units.la: Vaninus Naturam, seu universum mundum Deum esse docens perstringitur,I.107.a.
units.tr: Vanini, who teaches that Nature, or the whole universe, is God, is censured, I.107.a.

units.la: Vanitas Vanitatum Ecclesiastæ explicatur,I I.772.b.
units.tr: The Vanity of Vanities in Ecclesiastes is explained, I I.772.b.

units.la: Vaticiniorum obscuritas pendet ex illorum eventu ,I. 48.
units.tr: The obscurity of the prophecies depends on their fulfilment, I.48.

units.la: Ubi Angelorum quale? I.277.a.
units.tr: Where: what is the nature of angels? I.277.a.

units.la: Ubiquitas Dei, I.77. a. asseritur contra Vorstium & Socin.ibid.78. b. ubiquitatis Naturæ Christi humanæ dogma unde ortum sit ? I I.18,a; confutatur,30.a.
units.tr: The ubiquity of God is asserted against Vorstius and Socinus, I.77.a. and 78.b. Whence arose the dogma of the ubiquity of Christ's human nature? I I.18.a.; it is refuted, 30.a.

units.la: Ubiquitarii ex Christi in cœlum ascensione refutantur, I I.66.b. quin & ex sessione carnis ejus ad dextram Patris,70. a.
units.tr: The Ubiquitarians are refuted from Christ's ascension into heaven, I I.66.b., and also from the sitting of his flesh at the right hand of the Father, 70.a.

units.la: Venale peccatum per se nullum est, I. 361. b. Pontificiorum argumenta solvuntur.362.a.
units.tr: Venial sin is in itself nothing, I.361.b. The arguments of the Papists are answered, 362.a.

units.la: Veracitas qualis virtus ? I.612.a. ei studendum , 542. b. 547. b.
units.tr: What kind of virtue is veracity? I.612.a. It must be pursued, 542.b. 547.b.

units.la: Verberum pœna apud Hebræos qualis fuerit? I.712,b. quomodo fieri fuerit? 713.a.
units.tr: What was the punishment of stripes among the Hebrews? I.712.b. How was it carried out? 713.a.

units.la: Verbum Dei scriptum de existentia Dei testatur,I. 65. b. ejus efficacia, 373. a. ejus auditus & studium commendatur, 528.a. cujus tres actus sunt, ibid. b. fides ei habenda,ib. attentio, in eum voluntatis.
units.tr: The written Word of God testifies to the existence of God, I.65.b. Its efficacy, 373.a. Its hearing and study are commended, 528.a. It has three acts, ibid. b. It is to be believed; faith is owed to it, ibid. Attention is directed to it by the will.

units.la: ibid.quot modis profanetur ? 549.b. eo electi efficaciter vocantur,I I.208.a. est vocatio externa, ib. b. non universalis, 209. a. cum interna Spiritus S. conjunctissima, 210. ejus prædicationis unde diversus apud auditores fructus? 212.a. 214.b. ejus prædicatio externa absque interna Spiritus S. operatione in convertendo homine inutilis est, 210. a. Verbum Dei prædicatum, an homo vel recipiendi vel rejiciendi libertatem habeat? 219.a. illud non ex Ecclesiæ testimonio, sed Ecclesia ex Verbo Dei cognoscitur,521.quid sit & quale? 561. a.
units.tr: ibid. In how many ways is it profaned? 549.b. By it the elect are effectually called, I I.208.a. There is an external calling, ib. b., not universal, 209.a., most closely joined with the internal operation of the Holy Spirit, 210. Why does the preaching of the Word bear diverse fruit among hearers? 212.a. 214.b. Its external preaching without the internal operation of the Holy Spirit is useless in converting a man, 210.a. When the Word of God is preached, does a man have the freedom either to receive or to reject it? 219.a. The Word is known not from the testimony of the Church, but the Church is known from the Word of God, 521. What is it, and of what kind? 561.a.

units.la: Verbum Sacramentale Christi institutionis Sacramentum facit,I.394.a.
units.tr: The Word of sacramental institution by Christ makes the sacrament, I.394.a.

units.la: Verecundia quid? I.589.b.
units.tr: What is modesty? I.589.b.

units.la: Veritas. Eam inquirendi Ecclesiæ traditio non tollit, 1. 15. b. fundamentalis quid sit? 16.a. in Scripturis divinissimè exprimitur,ibid. b.
units.tr: Truth. The tradition of the Church does not remove the inquiry into it, I.15.b. What is fundamental truth? 16.a. It is most divinely expressed in the Scriptures, ibid. b.

units.la: Vernas quia? quotuplex? I. 622. a. falsa ejus origo à Politicis ostenditur,622.b. cur præcepta sit? 623,a. Veritatis & charitatis συζυγία,II.585.b.
units.tr: Lying: why? How many kinds? I.622.a. Its false origin is shown by the political writers, 622.b. Why was it forbidden? 623.a. The yoking together [συζυγία] of truth and charity, II.585.b.

units.la: Veritas & Veracitas Dei, I.96.a.
units.tr: The truth and veracity of God, I.96.a.

units.la: Veritas Religionis,I.523.b.
units.tr: The truth of religion, I.523.b.

units.la: Vermis conscientiæ malæ, I I.761.a.
units.tr: The worm of an evil conscience, I I.761.a.

units.la: Versio. Versionum Scripturæ utilitas & necessitas, I. 49. b. præstantiores sunt orientales, ibid. 50. Recentiores variæ, ibid. b. nulla absolutè authentica est,51.b.nec Vulgata Latina, ibid.
units.tr: Versions. The usefulness and necessity of versions of Scripture, I.49.b. The eastern ones are more excellent, ibid. 50. The more recent ones are various, ibid. b. None is absolutely authentic, 51.b., nor is the Latin Vulgate, ibid.

units.la: Vestis, qua coram Deo comparere oportet,II.286.a.
units.tr: The garment in which one must appear before God, II.286.a.

units.la: Vestitus Hebræorum Veterum refertur, I. 671.a. ubi quæ cavenda; quæ observanda fuerunt,ibid 689. b. Religiosi mystica significatio,689.b.
units.tr: The clothing of the ancient Hebrews is described, I.671.a. What had to be avoided and what observed, ibid. 689.b. The mystical signification of the religious dress, 689.b.

units.la: Vetus homo quomodo deponatur ? I.130.b. 231.
units.tr: How is the old man put off? I.130.b. 231.

units.la: Via Scripturæ tutior est quàm authoritatis Ecclesiæ, I. 31. a.
units.tr: The way of Scripture is safer than the authority of the Church, I.31.a.

units.la: Vicarium lui in Ecclesia Christus nullum instituit, I I. 649. b. Vicarius Christi in terris , est Antichristus, 690. b.
units.tr: Christ instituted no vicar for himself in the Church, I I.649.b. The vicar of Christ on earth is Antichrist, 690.b.

units.la: Vicissitudines Ecclesiæ lucis & umbræ, &c. exponuntui,I I. 539.
units.tr: The vicissitudes of the Church, of light and shadow, and so on, are expounded, I I.539.

units.la: Victima. Quale sacrificii genus ?I,654.a. Victimarum electus habendus fuit, ibid. earum quatuor genera, 654. b. victimis piacularibus pœna vicaria irrogata est,657.a. fuerunt typi Sacrificii Christi, qui vices nostras subiit, ib. b. quænam & quando comedi solebant? 660.a. Victimarum solennium pro toto cœtu oblatarum spiritualis significatio, 677. b. Victima piacularis Christus pro peccatis fuit, I I. 104.105.a. 112.a.
units.tr: Victim. What kind of sacrifice is it? I.654.a. The choice of victims had to be considered, ibid. Their four kinds, 654.b. A vicarious punishment was inflicted on expiatory victims, 657.a. They were types of the sacrifice of Christ, who took our place, ib. b. Which were eaten, and when? 660.a. The spiritual significance of the solemn victims offered for the whole congregation, 677.b. Christ was the expiatory victim for sins, I I.104, 105.a. 112.a.

units.la: Victoria .Christi de Sathana perfectissima est, I.393. a. fidelium super hostes,374.b.
units.tr: The victory of Christ over Satan is most perfect, I.393.a. The victory of believers over their enemies, 374.b.

units.la: Videri quomodo Deus in Scripturis dicatur ? I.74.a.
units.tr: In what way is God said in Scripture to be seen? I.74.a.

units.la: Vindex. Vindicis sanguinis jus quale fuerit ? I.715.b.
units.tr: Avenger. What was the right of the avenger of blood? I.715.b.

units.la: Vindicta. quomodo superioribus competat ?I. 569. b. quid sit? 578.b. 581.b.
units.tr: Vengeance. How does it belong to superiors? I.569.b. What is it? 578.b. 581.b.

units.la: Vinum S. Cœnæ quale symbolum sit. II.467. b. aquâ dilui non opus est, ibid. ritus Christi circa illud, 468.a.
units.tr: What kind of symbol is the wine of the Lord's Supper? II.467.b. It need not be diluted with water, ibid. Christ's rite concerning it, 468.a.

units.la: Virga Aharonis germinantis significatio, I.681.a.
units.tr: The significance of Aaron's rod that budded, I.681.a.

units.la: Virga Apostolica Pauli, 1.Cor,I V.12.non legislatoriam potestatem Ecclesiæ Ministris asserit,I I,647.a.
units.tr: Paul's apostolic rod, 1 Cor. IV.12. It does not assert a legislative power for the ministers of the Church, I I.647.a.

units.la: Virgines. Virginum παρθενία in Scriptura, & apud Athenicos lex , I. 591. b. cur occultatæ olim fuerint ? I I. 10. b.
units.tr: Virgins. Virginity [παρθενία] in Scripture, and the law of the Athenians concerning it, I.591.b. Why were they formerly kept hidden? I I.10.b.

units.la: Virginitas per se non est sanctitas corporis,I.590. a. ejus explorandæ ratio apud veteres Hebræos, 726. a. Virgo in urbe velagio compressa,de utraque legge, 716. b. de compressis & seductis ducendis legum ἐπιθεσις,717.b. Virginitas B.Mariæ, I I.9. b. 10. a, vindicatur adversus Judæos,11.b. 12.a.
units.tr: Virginity is not in itself holiness of body, I.590.a. The method of testing it among the ancient Hebrews, 726.a. A virgin violated in a city, with the law on each case, 716.b. Concerning compressed and seduced women and the penalty [ἐπιθεσις] under the laws, 717.b. The virginity of the Blessed Mary, I I.9.b. 10.a. It is vindicated against the Jews, 11.b. 12.a.

units.la: Virtutes Dei quales sint? I.94.b.
units.tr: What are the virtues of God? I.94.b.

units.la: Visibilis est Ecclesia externa,sed non omnibus,I I. 522. b. quomodo visibilis ? 523.a. visibilis quævis deficere potest, 529. a. reformari aliquando debet , 530. b.
units.tr: The external Church is visible, but not to everyone, I I.522.b. In what way is it visible? 523.a. Any visible church can fail, 529.a. It must sometimes be reformed, 530.b.

units.la: Visio Prophetica qualis fuerit ? I.480. a.
units.tr: What kind of prophetic vision was it? I.480.a.

units.la: Visio Dei beatifica cœlitum qualis sit ? I.74. a. Visio & perfecta Dei cognitio,est summi boni perfecta fruitio , II. 776. quæ nec Essentiæ Dei comprehensio, nec arida Dei contemplatio est,ib. b. cujus certiora explicautur,777.a.
units.tr: The beatific vision of God among the heavenly ones: what is it? I.74.a. Vision and perfect knowledge of God is the perfect enjoyment of the highest good, II.776. It is neither a comprehension of God's essence nor a dry contemplation of God, ib. b. Its more certain features are explained, 777.a.

units.la: Visitatio Dei quid ? I I.4.a.
units.tr: What is the visitation of God? I I.4.a.

units.la: Vita Dei explicatur , I. 80. b. Christo æquè ac Patri attribuitur,128.129.
units.tr: The life of God is explained, I.80.b. It is ascribed to Christ equally with the Father, 128, 129.

units.la: Vita Christi privata,I I.38. a. seqq. publica ,40. seqq vita ἀγαπικλητ indissolubilis Christi Sacerdotis tis explicatur, II.103.a.
units.tr: The life of Christ: private, II.38.a. following; public, 40 following. The indissoluble [ἀγαπικλητ] life of Christ the Priest is explained, II.103.a.

units.la: Vita humana. Ejus terminus cuivis homini à Deo destinatus & immutabilis est, I 258. a. vitæ longævitas quâ conditione à Deo promittatur? 259 a.
units.tr: Human life. Its term, appointed by God for each man, is fixed and unchangeable, I.258.a. On what condition does God promise length of life? 259.a.

units.la: Vitæ supernaturalis principium homo naturalis nullum habet, I I.222. a.
units.tr: Natural man has no principle of supernatural life, I I.222.a.

units.la: Vita Christiana definitur. I.339.a.
units.tr: The Christian life is defined, I.339.a.

units.la: Vita æterna. Ejus adjudicatio est altera pars Justificationis, I. 296. a. protoplastis à Deo promissa fuit, 319. a. Vita nova æterna est, II.399. a. definitur & synonyma ejus colliguntur, II.767. b. variis argumentis ejus existentia astruitur, 768. a. eam negantium elenchus, 769.eam dat communiter Deus Triunus, singulariter Filius, 769. in quibus rebus consistat? 770. viribus naturæ impetrari nequit, ib. a. ejusdem participes erunt omnes electi secundum corpus & animam, 770.b. in carentia malorum & summi boni fruitione consistit, 771. 772. cujus initium in hac vita, consummatio in altera est, 775. b. vide Visio Dei. ejus lætitia ineffabilis est, 778. b. eâque in solo Deo, 779.a.
units.tr: Eternal life. Its award is the other part of justification, I.296.a. It was promised by God to the first parents, 319.a. New life is eternal, II.399.a. It is defined and its synonyms are gathered, II.767.b. Its existence is established by various arguments, 768.a. Refutation of those who deny it, 769. It is given commonly by the Triune God, and singularly by the Son, 769. In what things it consists, 770. It cannot be obtained by the powers of nature, ib. a. All the elect will share in it, body and soul, 770.b. It consists in the absence of evils and the enjoyment of the highest good, 771, 772. Its beginning is in this life, its consummation in the next, 775.b. See Vision of God. Its joy is ineffable, 778.b., and found in God alone, 779.a.

units.la: Vitulus in deserto & post in Dan & Bethel quot a idola fuerint? I.554.b. ille in deserto non fuit Apis Ægyptiorum, 651.a.
units.tr: The calf in the desert, and afterwards at Dan and Bethel: how many idols were there? I.554.b. The one in the desert was not the Apis of the Egyptians, 651.a.

units.la: Ultor peccati Deus est, I.99.a.
units.tr: God is the avenger of sin, I.99.a.

units.la: Umbræ futurorum ceremoniæ V. Testam. fuerunt, I. 692.b. 693. a.
units.tr: The ceremonies of the Old Testament were shadows of things to come, I.692.b. 693.a.

units.la: Una quomodo fit & dicatur Ecclesia. II.544.a.
units.tr: How is the Church made one, and how is it called one? II.544.a.

units.la: Unctio Sacerdotum, I. 669. a. Regum Israelit. qualis fuerit? 705. a. Unctionis extremæ Pontificiæ Sacramentum rejicitur, II.501.b.
units.tr: The anointing of priests, I.669.a. What was the anointing of the kings of Israel? I.705.a. The sacrament of the Papists' extreme unction is rejected, II.501.b.

units.la: Unctio Spiritus S. qualis sit? I.145.b. ab ea Christi nomen dicitur, II. 76 b. 77. a. Unctio Christi in quo consistat? 77.78. triplex est; æterna, in diebus carnis, & in cœlo, ibid. ideo omnibus unctis Prophetis præstantior.79.a. ad officium triplex, 87.a.
units.tr: The anointing of the Holy Spirit: what kind is it? I.145.b. The name Christ is derived from it, II.76.b. 77.a. In what does the anointing of Christ consist? 77, 78. It is threefold: eternal, in the days of the flesh, and in heaven, ibid. Hence he is more excellent than all the anointed prophets, 79.a. Concerning the threefold office, 87.a.

units.la: Unio. ejus variæ species, I I.19.a. Sacramentalis, signum inter & rem significatam nonnisi relativa est, I.395. b. 396. a.
units.tr: Union: its various species, II.19.a. Sacramental union: the relation between the sign and the thing signified is only relative, I.395.b. 396.a.

units.la: Unio Naturarum in Persona Christi, quomodo facta? I 1.18.a. modus exponitur mysterio plenus, ibid. b. κατ' ἀρειν ἀσυγχύτως, ἀτρέπτως & ἀχωρίστως, 19. a. κατα ζῳον, ibid. b. Hypostatica est, ibid. non est parastatica, ibid. in ejus nativitate manifestata est, 24. a. eorum circa hoc dogma er antium elenchus, 17. a.
units.tr: Union of the natures in the Person of Christ: how was it effected? II.18.a. The mode is explained, full of mystery, ibid. b. Without confusion, without change, and inseparably [κατ᾽ ἀρειν ἀσυγχύτως, ἀτρέπτως & ἀχωρίστως], 19.a. [κατα ζῳον], ibid. b. It is hypostatic, ibid. It is not parastatic, ibid. It was manifested in his nativity, 24.a. Refutation of the heretics who opposed this dogma, 17.a.

units.la: Unio & communio cum Deo certitudinem Salutis confirmat, I I.416. a.
units.tr: Union and communion with God confirm the certainty of salvation, I. 416 a.

units.la: Unio Christum inter & fideles, est ut capitis cum corpore, I.390.391. indissolubilis est, 396. a. Ecclesiæ cum capite Christo & membrorum inter se, qualis fit? II.509.b. an sit nota veræ Ecclesiæ, 548.b.
units.tr: Union between Christ and the faithful is like that of head and body, I. 390, 391; it is indissoluble, 396 a. What sort of union is there between the Church and Christ its head, and between the members themselves? II. 509 b. Is it a mark of the true Church? 548 b.

units.la: Unitas & Unicitas Dei explicatur, I. I 2.
units.tr: Unity and uniqueness of God are explained, I. 12.

units.la: Universalis electio non est I. 168 a. 169.a. universalis singulorum hominum vocatio refutatur, I I 209. universalis Ecclesiæ Episcopus non Papa sed Christus est, 642.
units.tr: Universal election is not true, I. 168 a, 169 a. The universal calling of all individual men is refuted, I. 209. The universal bishop of the Church is not the Pope but Christ, 642.

units.la: Universalitas efficaciæ mortis Christi non datur, II. 125. b.
units.tr: Universality of the efficacy of Christ's death is not granted, II. 125 b.

units.la: Unus. Deus unus est absolute, I.72.a. ergo una etiam Religio, 512. b. Unum Fœdus gratiæ in V. & N. T. 403. b. unus Mediator, 404. unum Testamentum gratiæ, 408. a.
units.tr: One. God is one absolutely, I. 72 a; therefore there is also one religion, 512 b. One covenant of grace in the Old and New Testament, 403 b. One Mediator, 404. One Testament of grace, 408 a.

units.la: Vocabula S.S. Trinitatis Mysterium notantia, qualia & quâ cautione adhibenda, I 110. b.
units.tr: Terms of the Holy Trinity: the words signifying the mystery of the Holy Trinity, what they are, and with what caution they are to be used, I. 110 b.

units.la: Vocandi ad Ministerium examinari debent, II. 569. a. veteris Ecclesiæ praxis, 570.b.
units.tr: Those to be called to the ministry must be examined, II. 569 a. The practice of the ancient Church, 570 b.

units.la: Vocatio Ministrorum ad Ecclesiam pertinet, II. 544. b. ejus necessitas, 565.a. quotuplex, ibid. b. mediata fit ab Ecclesia, 566. 567.a, cui vocandi jus competat? 568.a. exercitium, ib. b. Reformatorum Ecclesiæ legitima fuit, 572. b.
units.tr: The calling of ministers belongs to the Church, II. 544 b. Its necessity, 565 a. How many kinds there are, ibid. b. It is made mediately by the Church, 566, 567 a. To whom does the right of calling belong? 568 a. Its exercise, ibid. b. The calling in the Reformed Churches was lawful, 572 b.

units.la: Vocationis ordinariæ necessitas, I. 607. a.
units.tr: The necessity of the ordinary calling, I. 607 a.

units.la: Vocationis Gratiæ origo ostenditur, II.104.b. definitur, ib. vid. Breviar. æterna qualis sit? 205. b. externa non est universalis, 209. ei resisti non potest, 207. electorum externa cum interna Spiritus S. conjunctissima est, 210. a. externa absque gratia sufficiente, & proposito servandi vocatos, Dei sapientiæ, bonitati & æquitati repugnat, 229. b. Vocatio fidei donatio est, 239.b.
units.tr: The origin of the calling of grace is shown, II. 104 b. It is defined, ibid.; see Breviar. What is the eternal calling like? 205 b. The external calling is not universal, 209. It cannot be resisted, 207. The external calling of the elect is most closely joined with the internal calling of the Holy Spirit, 210 a. An external calling without sufficient grace, and without the purpose of preserving those called, is repugnant to the wisdom, goodness and justice of God, 229 b. The calling is a gift of faith, 239 b.

units.la: Vocatorum tria genera distinguuntur, II.507. b.
units.tr: Three kinds of called are distinguished, II. 507 b.

units.la: Voluntas Dei immutabilis quomodo sit? I. 80.a. ab essentia & intellectu Dei non differt, 88. b. nullam extra Deum causam habet, 89. a. vel signi vel beneplaciti, ibid. b. vel decernens vel præcipiens, ibid. in antecedentem & consequentem male distinguitur, ibid. 90.a. arcana vel revelata, 91.b. vid. Breviar. rerum omnium creatarum causa est, 150. a. Voluntas & intellectus in Deo, quoad rerum extra se existentiam, an necessitatem inferant? 248.b. voluntatem facere cur teneamur? 355. a. præcipientem inprimis, ibid. Voluntatis Divinæ efficacia, II. 205.a.
units.tr: The will of God: how is it immutable? I. 80 a. It does not differ from the essence and intellect of God, 88 b. It has no cause outside God, 89 a. It is either of sign or of good pleasure, ibid. b. It is either decreeing or commanding, ibid. It is wrongly divided into antecedent and consequent, ibid., 90 a. It is either secret or revealed, 91 b.; see Breviar. It is the cause of all created things, 150 a. Do will and intellect in God, as regards the existence of things outside himself, imply necessity? I. 248 b. Why are we bound to do the will [of God]? I. 355 a. Above all the preceptive will, ibid. The efficacy of the divine will, II. 205 a.

units.la: Voluntas Angelorum qualis? I. 275. b.
units.tr: The will of angels: what sort is it? I. 275 b.

units.la: Voluntaria & liberæ hominum actiones Providentiæ Dei subsunt, I.263.b.
units.tr: The voluntary and free actions of men are subject to the providence of God, I. 263 b.

units.la: Vorstius immensitatem Essentiæ Divinæ negans notatur, I.78.a. Voluntatem Dei mutabilem fatuit, 80. a. Justitiam judicialem Deo naturalem esse negans, notatur, 98.
units.tr: Vorstius is censured for denying the immensity of the divine essence, I. 78 a. He made the will of God mutable, 80 a. He is censured for denying that judicial justice is natural to God, 98.

units.la: Vossius (Isacus) de ætate mundi notatur, I.149.b.
units.tr: Vossius (Isaac) is censured concerning the age of the world, I. 149 b.

units.la: Votum definitur & explicatur, I. 367. a. vid. Breviar. Pontificia rejiciuntur, 369.b. legitima ex olvi debent, 370. a. vota Monastica prestringuntur, II. 169. a.
units.tr: A vow is defined and explained, I. 367 a.; see Breviar. Papist vows are rejected, 369 b. Lawful vows ought to proceed from faith, 370 a. Monastic vows are censured, II. 169 a.

units.la: Votiva Sacrificia quomodo fieri solita? I 655.b.
units.tr: Votive sacrifices: how were they customarily made? I. 655 b.

units.la: Vox Dei in Paradiso qualis fuerit?? 337. a.
units.tr: The voice of God in Paradise: what was it like? I. 337 a.

units.la: Ur Chaldæorum & Ur Babyloniæ differunt, I.417.a.
units.tr: Ur of the Chaldeans and Ur of Babylon differ, I. 417 a.

units.la: Urbanitas (seu ἐυτράπελια) qualis sit virtus? I.632.a.
units.tr: Urbanity (or eutrapelia): what sort of virtue is it? I. 632 a.

units.la: Urbes Levitarum XLVIII. fuerunt, I.664. b.
units.tr: The cities of the Levites were forty-eight, I. 664 b.

units.la: Urim & Thummim qualis revelationis Divinæ species fuerit? I.482. a. quibus ea conferre, & quibus in casibus licuerit? ibid. b. Spenceri commentum rejicitur, ibid. causa & usus hujus oraculi, 483.b.
units.tr: Urim and Thummim: what kind of divine revelation were they? I. 482 a. To whom were they to be given, and in which cases was it permitted? ibid. b. Spencer's fiction is rejected, ibid. The cause and use of this oracle, 483 b.

units.la: Uffērius Armachanus laudatur, I. 164. b.
units.tr: Ussher, Archbishop of Armagh, is praised, I. 164 b.

units.la: Usura, eam pro mutuo sumere Israelitis cur nefas fuerit? I.612. b. ejus rei rationes depromuntur, 613. a. hodie justa esse potest, 613. b.
units.tr: Usury: why was it wrong for Israelites to take it by way of loan? I. 612 b. The reasons for this are set out, 613 a. Today it can be just, 613 b.

units.la: Usus in concione quid sit? II. 596.
units.tr: Use in a sermon: what is it? II. 596.

units.la: Uterus Mariæ in Christi Nativitate apertus fuit, II. 24. a.
units.tr: Mary's womb was opened at the birth of Christ, II. 24 a.

units.la: Vulgata Versio Latina non est authentica, I. 51. b. vid. Versio.
units.tr: The Latin Vulgate version is not authentic, I. 51 b.; see Version.

units.la: Uxor. Ejus erga maritum officium, I.570.a. proximi cui non concupiscenda, 641. b.
units.tr: Wife. Her duty towards her husband, I. 570 a. The neighbour's wife, who is not to be coveted, 641 b.

units.la: W.
units.tr: W.

units.la: Wagenseilius commendatur, II.25. a. 60.a. contra Judæos scribens laudatur, 98. b. laudatur, 142. a. 144. b.
units.tr: Wagenseilius is commended, II.25. a. 60.a. Writing against the Jews he is praised, 98. b. he is praised, 142. a. 144. b.

units.la: Walenburgii Justitiam inhærentem causam formalem Justificationis statuentes, refutantur, I.271. a. arguuntur, 279. b.
units.tr: The Walenburgii, who maintain that inherent righteousness is the formal cause of justification, are refuted, I.271. a. they are censured, 279. b.

units.la: Weigelius ἀναμαγεννήσεως hominis regeniti tuetur, I. 237. a.
units.tr: Weigelius defends the ἀναμαγεννήσεως [re-generation] of the regenerate man, I. 237. a.

units.la: Wiclefius Ecclesiæ Anglicanæ Reformator, II. 542. a.
units.tr: Wiclefius, the Reformer of the English Church, II. 542. a.

units.la: Wierus sagas excusans redarguitur, I.294. b.
units.tr: Wierus, who excuses witches, is refuted, I.294. b.

units.la: X.
units.tr: X.

units.la: Xerophagia non est jejunium, I.363. b.
units.tr: Xerophagia [ξηροφαγία] is not fasting, I.363. b.

units.la: Xystarches in lucta spirituali est Spiritus S, I.371.b.
units.tr: The Xystarches [ξυστάρχης] in spiritual wrestling is the Holy Spirit, I.371.b.

units.la: Y.
units.tr: Y.

units.la: Ὑπὲρ & ὑπὸ, pro & vice, vocularum emphasis in Redemtionis & Satisfactionis Christi negotio, II.110. b. seq.
units.tr: Hyper and hypo, pro and vice: the emphasis of these small words in the matter of Redemption and Christ's Satisfaction, II.110.b. and following. [ὑπὲρ & ὑπὸ]

units.la: Ὑπερτυγχάνειν quid? I.144.a.
units.tr: What is hypertygchanein? I.144.a. [ὑπερτυγχάνειν]

units.la: Ὑπόστασις una in Christo est, II.18.a. 19.b.
units.tr: There is one hypostasis in Christ, II.18.a., 19.b. [ὑπόστασις]

units.la: Ὑπόστασις ἐ πίστεως quid? II.255.b. amplius 256,b.
units.tr: What is hypostasis of faith? II.255.b.; more fully 256.b. [ὑπόστασις ἐ πίστεως]

units.la: Z.
units.tr: Z.

units.la: Zabiorum superstitio, I 733.b. 734.a. Idololatria, ib.
units.tr: Superstition of the Zabii, I. 733.b. 734.a. Idolatry, ib.

units.la: Zelotarum jus apud Hebræos quale fuerit? I. 715.a.
units.tr: What was the right of the Zealots among the Hebrews? I. 715.a.

units.la: Zelotypia potius, & de eodem lex, I. 724. b. Mysterium ex ejus ritu erutum, 72 ;.a.
units.tr: Jealousy rather, and the law concerning it, I. 724.b. A mystery drawn out of its rite, 725.a.

units.la: Zelus perversus Pauli, I.373. a.
units.tr: The perverse zeal of Paul, I. 373.a.

units.la: Zisca Bohemorum patrum strenuus Dux, II. 542.a.
units.tr: Zisca, the vigorous leader of the Bohemian fathers, II. 542.a.

units.la: Zizaniorum mixtura cum tritico in Ecclesia externa semper fuit, est & erit, II. 524.b. fusius explicatur parabola, 527.b 534.b. Antichristiani Regni & verae Ecclesiae Christi, 539. a. Zizania eradicare quo sensu voluerit Christus? I.585.a.587.a.
units.tr: The mixture of tares with the wheat in the external Church has always been, is, and will be; II. 524.b. The parable is explained more fully at 527.b and 534.b. The Antichristian kingdom and the true Church of Christ, 539.a. In what sense did Christ intend the tares to be uprooted? I. 585.a. 587.a.

units.la: Zwinglius externorum incuriosus, internorum & spiritualium tenacissimus fuit, II. 443. a. Idem de Magistratus potestate vindicatur, 622. b.
units.tr: Zwingli was careless of external things and most tenacious of inward and spiritual ones, II. 443.a. The same matter concerning the power of the magistrate is defended at 622.b.

units.la: INDEX Vocum Hebræarum, quarum significatio & emphasis in hoc opere vel explicatur, vel vindicatur.
units.tr: Index of Hebrew Words, whose meaning and emphasis are either explained or defended in this work.

units.la: א
units.tr: Aleph [א]

units.la: אב pater unde dicatur? I.564.a.
units.tr: Ab [אב], father: whence is it derived? I.564.a.

units.la: אבר non annihilationem rei, sed defitionem & esse quod fuit, significat, I.754.755.a.
units.tr: Abar [אבר]: it signifies not the annihilation of a thing but its departure and continuing to be what it was, I.754, 755.a.

units.la: אחרי Dei videre Exod.XXXIII.20. quid sit. I.73.b.
units.tr: Achare [אחרי]: seeing God (Exod. 33:20): what it means, I.73.b.

units.la: אחרית ימים quid? II.144.b.
units.tr: Acharith yamim [אחרית ימים]: what is it? II.144.b.

units.la: אלה אלהים quale Dei nomen sit, I.69.b, cur plural. numeri sit, cum nonnisi unum Deum notet, I.188.b.
units.tr: Elah, Elohim [אלה אלהים]: what kind of name of God it is, I.69.b; why it is plural in number, when it denotes only one God, I.188.b.

units.la: אמונה fides ab אמן derivata quid notet, II.239.b. & האמין πιστευειν εἰς Χριστὸν quid? 252.b.
units.tr: Emunah [אמונה], faith, derived from Aman [אמן]: what does it signify, II.239.b? And he-amin [האמין], to believe in Christ [πιστεύειν εἰς Χριστόν]: what is it? 252.b.

units.la: אנשים cur Judices Israelitarum dicti fuerint, I.704.a.
units.tr: Anashim [אנשים]: why the judges of Israel were so called, I.704.a.

units.la: ארון Arca foederis qualis fuerit, I.35.b.
units.tr: Aron [ארון], the Ark of the covenant: what it was like, I.35.b.

units.la: אשם quid significet? II.106.b. 122.b. fuit sacrificium pro reatu, I.656.a. quomodo à sacrificio חטאה differat, 657.a. quomodo Christus tale pro nobis factus sit. II.112.b.
units.tr: Asham [אשם]: what does it signify? II.106.b, 122.b. It was a sacrifice for guilt, I.656.a. How does it differ from the sacrifice Chattath [חטאה], 657.a. How Christ was made such an offering for us, II.112.b.

units.la: את Præpositio qualem emphasin notet, I.564.a.
units.tr: Eth [את], a preposition: what emphasis does it carry? I.564.a.

units.la: ב
units.tr: Beth [ב]

units.la: בעל quid varie constructum significet, I.468.
units.tr: Baal [בעל]: what does it signify in its various constructions? I.468.

units.la: בשגגה per errorem committere quid? I 580.a.
units.tr: Bishgagah [בשגגה], to commit through error: what is it? I.580.a.

units.la: בראשית & reliqua prima verba Genesis non sunt epitome totius creationis, I.158.b.
units.tr: Bereshith [בראשית]: the first words of Genesis, and the rest of them, are not an epitome of the whole creation, I.158.b.

units.la: ברית & διαθηκη seu fœdus & διαθηκη seu Testamentum significat, I.386.b. unde dictum sit? 303.a.
units.tr: Berith [ברית], diathēkē [διαθήκη], that is, covenant [foedus], and diathēkē [διαθήκη], that is, testament: what does it signify? I.386.b. Whence is it so called? 303.a.

units.la: כרת ברית secare fœdus quid, & unde dictum? ib. I.05.b.
units.tr: Karath berith [כרת ברית], to cut a covenant: what is it, and whence is it derived? ib. I.565.b. (sic)

units.la: ברית עולם fœdus æternum, an semper tale notet? I.558.b. quomodo circumcisio dicatur, 452.a.
units.tr: Berith olam [ברית עולם], everlasting covenant: does it always signify such? I.558.b. In what sense is circumcision called this? 452.a.

units.la: בת קול filia vocis quid fuerit? I.438.b.
units.tr: Bath kol [בת קול], daughter of a voice: what was it? I.438.b.

units.la: ג
units.tr: Gimel [ג]

units.la: גאלה redemptio hæreditatis; item, ejusdem jus est, I.731.b.
units.tr: Geullah [גאלה], redemption of an inheritance; likewise, the right of redeeming it: I.731.b.

units.la: גואל הדם Vindex sanguinis V.T. qualis fuerit, I.582.a. quodnam ipsius jus fuerit, 715.b.
units.tr: Goel ha-dam [גואל הדם], the avenger of blood in the Old Testament: what was he like? I.582.a. What was his right? 715.b.

units.la: גלגל המתים revolutio mortuorum quale Judæorum commentum, II.742.a.
units.tr: Galgal ha-metim [גלגל המתים], the revolution of the dead: what a fiction of the Jews it is, II.742.a.

units.la: ד
units.tr: Daleth [ד]

units.la: דמות & צלם an & quomodo differant? I.508.a.
units.tr: Demuth and Tselem [דמות & צלם]: do they differ, and how? I.508.a.

units.la: ה
units.tr: He [ה]

units.la: הוא pro היא in Codice Hispan. positum est, I.35.
units.tr: Hu [הוא] is put for hi [היא] in the Spanish codex, I.35.

units.la: היא pro הוא alibi Pontificii falsò substituunt. I.413.b.
units.tr: Hi [היא] is falsely substituted by the Papists elsewhere for hu [הוא]. I.413.b.

units.la: היום Hodie Psal.2:7. æternitatem notat, I.110.a.
units.tr: Hayom [היום], today, Psalm 2:7, denotes eternity, I.110.a.

units.la: הצדיק quid significet, I.163.a.
units.tr: Ha-tsaddiq [הצדיק]: what does it signify? I.163.a.

units.la: השתחויה qualem adorationem significet, I.524.a. 527.a.
units.tr: Hishtachawah [השתחויה]: what kind of adoration does it signify? I.524.a, 527.a.

units.la: ו
units.tr: Vav [ו]

units.la: זבחים victima quàle sacrificii genus? I.654.a. earum quatuor species, 654.b. 652.a.
units.tr: Zebachim [זבחים], victims: what kind of sacrifice? I.654.a. Their four species, 654.b, 652.a.

units.la: זרון proterva, hinc phrasis, בזרון per proterviam aliquid committere, I.580.b.
units.tr: Zaron [זרון], insolence; hence the phrase bezaron [בזרון], to commit something through insolence: I.580.b.

units.la: נאף & זנה quomodo differant, I.588.b. 597.
units.tr: Naaph [נאף] and Zanah [זנה]: how do they differ? I.588.b, 597.

units.la: זקנים Presbyteri quales in Ecclesia Judaica, II.580.
units.tr: Zeqenim [זקנים], elders: what were they like in the Jewish Church? II.580.

units.la: זרע Semen quomodo de Christo dicatur, I.9.b.
units.tr: Zera [זרע], seed: how is it said of Christ? I.9.b.

units.la: ח
units.tr: Heth [ח]

units.la: חדש qualem novitatem significet, I I.159.a.
units.tr: Chadash [חדש]: what kind of newness does it signify? I.159.a.

units.la: חידה & מליצה oratio clara & ænigma quomodo differant, I.12.b.
units.tr: Chidah and Melitsah [חידה & מליצה], clear speech and enigma: how do they differ? I.12.b.

units.la: חזון visio qualis fuerit, II.157.a.
units.tr: Chazon [חזון], vision: what was it like? II.157.a.

units.la: חטאה quale peccatum significet, I.329.a. ejusdem synonyma Hebræa, ib. significat etiam sacrificium piaculare pro peccato, 656.a. 657.a.
units.tr: Chattath [חטאה]: what kind of sin does it signify? I.329.a. Its Hebrew synonyms, ib. It also signifies a sin-offering for sin, 656.a, 657.a.

units.la: חכמה ובינה sapientia & intelligentia in sacris Theologiam notant, I.2.b.
units.tr: Chokhmah and Binah [חכמה ובינה], wisdom and understanding, in the sacred writings denote theology, I.2.b.

units.la: חליפה qualem mutationem, Psal.CIJ.27. notet, I I.750.b. 754.b. 755.a.
units.tr: Chalifah [חליפה]: what kind of change does it denote in Psalm 102:27? II.750.b, 754.b, 755.a.

units.la: חסד gratiam cum studio boni significat, I.97.a. II.406.b.
units.tr: Chesed [חסד], grace, with a zeal for good, I.97.a, II.406.b.

units.la: חקים & חקות qualia statuta notent, I.647. non semper, uti Judæi interpretantur, Ritus significant, I I.160.a.
units.tr: Chuqqim and chuqqoth [חקים & חקות]: what kinds of statutes do they denote? I.647. They do not always, as the Jews interpret, signify rites, II.160.a.

units.la: חרם anathema quale apud Hebræos fuerit, I.714.a. ejus 4. species, ib.
units.tr: Cherem [חרם], anathema: what was it among the Hebrews? I.714.a. Its four species, ib.

units.la: חתך Dan. I X. quid significet? II.142.143.a.
units.tr: Chatak [חתך], Dan. 9: what does it signify? II.142, 143.a.

units.la: חתם נביאים sigillum prophetarum cur Malachias dicatur, I.35.a. 37.b.
units.tr: Chatham nevi'im [חתם נביאים], seal of the prophets: why is Malachi so called? I.35.a, 37.b.

units.la: ט
units.tr: Teth [ט]

units.la: טטפות Totaphot frontalia quid fuerint? I.671.a.
units.tr: Totaphot [טטפות], frontlets: what were they? I.671.a.

units.la: י
units.tr: Yod [י]

units.la: ידע γινωσκειν cognoscere Dei in sacris quid notet, I.166.a. De Viro vel uxore dictum quid? II.9.b.
units.tr: Yada [ידע], to know [γινώσκειν]: what does it denote in the sacred writings of knowing God? I.166.a. What is said of a man or wife? II.9.b.

units.la: יה proprium Dei nomen, I.69.a.
units.tr: Yah [יה], the proper name of God, I.69.a.

units.la: יהוה nomen Dei essentiale, I.67.b. Deo proprium, 68.a. 72.a. quomodo aliquando etiam rebus creatis tribuatur, ibid.b. De ejus pronuntiatione, ibid. 68.b.
units.tr: Yahweh [יהוה], the essential name of God, I.67.b. Proper to God, 68.a, 72.a. How is it sometimes ascribed also to created things? ibid.b. Of its pronunciation, ibid., 68.b.

units.la: יובל Jobel quid significet, I.685.b. 686.a.
units.tr: Yobel [יובל], Jubilee: what does it signify? I.685.b, 686.a.

units.la: ישרה rectitudo Dei quid notat? I.95.b.
units.tr: Yashar [ישרה], the uprightness of God: what does it denote? I.95.b.

units.la: כ
units.tr: Kaph [כ]

units.la: כבד qualem honoris gradum notet? I.564.b.
units.tr: Kabod [כבד]: what degree of honour does it denote? I.564.b.

units.la: כהן Sacerdotem cur notet? I I.102.a.
units.tr: Kohen [כהן], priest: why does it denote this? II.102.a.

units.la: כלאים heterogenium quid in lege sit, II.734.a.
units.tr: Kilayim [כלאים], heterogeneous things: what is it in the law? II.734.a.

units.la: כפר quid notat? I I.107.b.
units.tr: Kaphar [כפר]: what does it denote? II.107.b.

units.la: כפרה aliquando idem significat quod פרה II. 109.a.
units.tr: Kaparah [כפרה] sometimes signifies the same as Parah [פרה]. II.109.a.

units.la: כפורים festi expiationis mysterium, I.683.a.
units.tr: Kippurim [כפורים], the mystery of the festival of atonement: I.683.a.

units.la: כפרת ἱλαστήριον Propitiatorium quale fuerit, 681. ejus mysterium, ibid.
units.tr: Kapporeth [כפרת], hilastērion [ἱλαστήριον], the propitiatory: what was it like? 681. Its mystery, ibid.

units.la: כרת Excidii pœna qualis fuerit, I.713.b.
units.tr: Karath [כרת], the penalty of excision: what was it like? I.713.b.

units.la: ל
units.tr: Lamed [ל]

units.la: לילית Iamia seu strix, I.294.b.
units.tr: Lilith [לילית], Iamia, or screech-owl: I.294.b.

units.la: לון ossiculum inferioris dorsi, quod Judæi semen esse resuscitandi corporis, nuganiur, I I.735.b.
units.tr: Luz [לון], the little bone of the lower back, which the Jews foolishly claim is the seed of the resurrection of the body: II.735.b.

units.la: מ
units.tr: Mem [מ]

units.la: מדבר loquens, λογος Christus dicitur, I I.87.b.
units.tr: Medabber [מדבר], speaking one, logos [λόγος]: Christ is so called, II.87.b.

units.la: מימרא Verbum Christo tributum Divinitatem ejus probat, idem est quod λογος, Joh.1. I.128.a.
units.tr: Memra [מימרא], Word: ascribed to Christ, it proves his divinity; it is the same as logos [λόγος], John 1. I.128.a.

units.la: כזוזות Postes ædium, quid? I.671.a.
units.tr: Mezuzoth [מזוזות], doorposts of houses: what are they? I.671.a.

units.la: מזכיר Regis Hebræorum qualis fuerit, I.709.b.
units.tr: Mazkir [מזכיר] of the Hebrew kings: what was he like? I.709.b.

units.la: מחוקק Legislator qualis intelligatur? I.434.a.
units.tr: Mechoqeq [מחוקק], lawgiver: how is he to be understood? I.434.a.

units.la: מכשף praestigiator, I.292.b. qua poena afficiendus sit, 294. b.
units.tr: Mekhashshef [מכשף], a sorcerer: I.292.b. With what penalty is he to be punished? 294.b.

units.la: מזורה Mal. I.11. ejus significatio contra Abarbanelis detorsiones vindicatur, I.694. b.
units.tr: Mezorah [מזורה], Mal. 1:11: its meaning is defended against the distortions of Abarbanel, I.694.b.

units.la: מנחה & מנחות Donaria, seu feria qualia sacrificia fuerint, I.652.a.676. b. Gentilium qualia, 653. b. 677. b.
units.tr: Minchah and minchoth [מנחה & מנחות], gifts, or votive offerings: what kinds of sacrifices they were, I.652.a, 676.b. Those of the Gentiles, what kind, 653.b, 677.b.

units.la: מראה Visio Prophetica qualis fuerit, I. 480.a.
units.tr: Mar'ah [מראה], the prophetic vision: what was it like? I.480.a.

units.la: מרגלים Exploratores quinam fuerint. I. 735. a.
units.tr: Meraglim [מרגלים], the spies: who were they? I.735.a.

units.la: משיח Jesu nomen proprium, I 1.77.a. cur LXX. per Messiam reddiderint, ibid. Etiam ethnicis hoc nomen innotuit, ibid.
units.tr: Mashiach [משיח], the proper name of Jesus, I.77.a. Why did the Seventy render it by Messias? ibid. This name was also known to the heathen, ibid.

units.la: משפט quid significet, I.700.a.
units.tr: Mishpat [משפט]: what does it signify? I.700.a.

units.la: נביא Prophetam, non Oratorem publicum, sed hominem προφήτην notat, I. 34. b. Prophetæ quinam fuerint, 438. a.
units.tr: Nabi [נביא] denotes a prophet, not a public orator, but a man who is prophētēs [προφήτης]: I.34.b. Who were the prophets? 438.a.

units.la: נרוי qualis excommunicationis species fuerit, I. 714. a.
units.tr: Nidui [נרוי]: what kind of excommunication was it? I.714.a.

units.la: נסך libamen quale sacrificium fuerit, I.652.a.
units.tr: Nesekh [נסך], a libation: what kind of sacrifice was it? I.652.a.

units.la: נער & נערה unde dicantur, I.572.a.
units.tr: Naar and naarah [נער & נערה]: whence are they so called? I.572.a.

units.la: נקבה foeminam, seu sexum foemineum notat, II. 11. b.
units.tr: Neqevah [נקבה] denotes a female, or the female sex: II.11.b.

units.la: נשיאים Principes Sacerdotum quinam in V. T. & cur ita dicti? 11.670.a.
units.tr: Nesi'im [נשיאים], the princes of the priests: who were they in the Old Testament, and why so called? II.670.a.

units.la: נשך quale usurae genus fuerit, I.612.b.
units.tr: Neshekh [נשך]: what kind of usury was it? I.612.b.

units.la: נפש & נשמה an differant? I.217.a.
units.tr: Nephesh and neshamah [נפש & נשמה]: do they differ? I.217.a.

units.la: סגלה peculium Dei quomodo Judæi fuerint? I. 470. b. 473. b.
units.tr: Segullah [סגלה], the peculiar people of God: in what sense were the Jews so? I.470.b, 473.b.

units.la: סבך an ὑποσκιάζειν obumbrare significet? II. 13. a.
units.tr: Sabakh [סבך]: does it signify hyposkiazein [ὑποσκιάζειν], to overshadow? II.13.a.

units.la: סנהדרים Sanhedrim seu Synedria Hebræorum quid fuerint, I.707.a. duravit hic consessus usque ad Christum, 707. ejusdem infallibilitas ab Hebræis asserta refellitur, 708.
units.tr: Sanhedrin, or Synedria, of the Hebrews: what were they? I.707.a. This council lasted until Christ, 707. Its infallibility, asserted by the Hebrews, is refuted, 708.

units.la: ספרים Scribæ Hebræorum quales fuerint, I.709. a. vide Scribæ.
units.tr: Sopherim [ספרים], scribes of the Hebrews: what were they like? I.709.a. See Scribes.

units.la: עבודה qualem cultum significet? I.524.b.
units.tr: Avodah [עבודה]: what kind of worship does it denote? I.524.b.

units.la: עדה qualem cætum significet: I. 709. a. quomodo à קהל differat, II.505.
units.tr: Edah [עדה]: what kind of assembly does it denote? I.709.a. How does it differ from Qahal [קהל]? II.505.

units.la: עולם Seculum quid sit? I.326.b.
units.tr: Olam [עולם], age: what is it? I.326.b.

units.la: עולם הזה & עולם הבוא seculum præsens & futurum quid sit, II.144.b.
units.tr: Olam ha-zeh and olam ha-ba [עולם הזה & עולם הבוא], the present and future age: what are they? II.144.b.

units.la: עלמה qualem puellam significet, II.10.b. non conjugem, b. Virginem notat, 11. a. b.
units.tr: Almah [עלמה]: what kind of girl does it denote? II.10.b. Not a wife, ib. It denotes a virgin, II.11.a, b.

units.la: על idem quod ὑπὲρ pro significat, II. 111. a. ubi de redemptione agitur.
units.tr: Al [על], the same as hyper [ὑπέρ], signifies for: II.111.a, where redemption is discussed.

units.la: עליון Altissimus Christus est, II.55.a.
units.tr: Elyon [עליון], the Most High, is Christ: II.55.a.

units.la: עם־סגלה Populus peculii Christi Regis hæreditas est, II.130.a.
units.tr: Am segullah [עם־סגלה], the people of Christ the King's peculiar possession, is an inheritance: II.130.a.

units.la: עמנו אל Immanuel Jesus est, I 11.11.a.
units.tr: Immanu El [עמנו אל], Immanuel, is Jesus: II.11.a.

units.la: עמית quid? I.129.b. ἰσον æqualem notat, ibid. 133.a.
units.tr: Amith [עמית]: what is it? I.129.b. It denotes isos [ἴσος], equal, ibid., 133.a.

units.la: עומר Omer quale sacrificium fuerit, I.652. b.
units.tr: Omer [עומר], the Omer: what kind of sacrifice was it? I.652.b.

units.la: עץ lignum, cur pro arbore ponatur, I.315.b.
units.tr: Ets [עץ], wood: why is it put for a tree? I.315.b.

units.la: עצם cur corpus significet, II.6.b.
units.tr: Etsem [עצם]: why does it denote a body? II.6.b.

units.la: ערוה nuditatem non γυμνότης significat, I. 590, 591. 592. a. turpitudinem notat, 593.b.
units.tr: Ervah [ערוה] does not signify nakedness, gymnotēs [γυμνότης]: I.590, 591, 592.a. It denotes shamefulness, 593.b.

units.la: ערות דבר λόγος πορνείας quid? I.593.b.
units.tr: Ervath davar [ערות דבר], logos porneias [λόγος πορνείας]: what is it? I.593.b.

units.la: ערב ἐγγυητὴς Sponsor quis est? 378. b.
units.tr: Arev [ערב], engyētēs [ἐγγυητής], a surety: who is he? 378.b.

units.la: פ & ם an Decalogi præcepta V. VII. VIII. IX. loco Silluk distinguant? I. 514.a. diversimode in Exodo & Deuteronomio adhibentur, ibid.b.
units.tr: Pe and Mem [פ & ם]: do the precepts of the Decalogue V, VII, VIII, IX distinguish by the Silluk instead? I.514.a. They are used in different ways in Exodus and Deuteronomy, ibid.b.

units.la: פדרה & פדיון redemptio τῆς ἀπολυτρώσεως respondent, II, 107. 109.a.
units.tr: Pidyon and pidyon [פדרה & פדיון] correspond to apolytrōsis [ἀπολύτρωσις], redemption: II.107, 109.a.

units.la: פסל qualis imago sit, I.531. b.
units.tr: Pesel [פסל]: what kind of image is it? I.531.b.

units.la: פלא mirabilis quomodo Christus sit, II.8.a, 18.b.
units.tr: Pele [פלא], wonderful: how is Christ wonderful? II.8.a, 18.b.

units.la: פלמוני quomodo Christus sit, II.87.b.
units.tr: Palmoni [פלמוני]: how is Christ so called? II.87.b.

units.la: פקר visitare quid in 11. præcepto Decalogi notet? I. 541.a.
units.tr: Paqad [פקר], to visit: what does it denote in the Second Commandment of the Decalogue? I.541.a.

units.la: פרקליט & קטיגור i.e. συνήγορος & κατήγορος apud Rabbinos opponuntur, I.617.a.
units.tr: Parqelit and qatigor, that is, synēgoros [συνήγορος] and katēgoros [κατήγορος], are opposed among the rabbis: I.617.a.

units.la: צדקה cur eleemosyna dicatur, I.617.b.
units.tr: Tsedaqah [צדקה]: why is it called alms? I.617.b.

units.la: צמח germen, Christus est, II.9.b.
units.tr: Tsemach [צמח], a shoot: Christ is it, II.9.b.

units.la: ציצית fimbria vestium Hebræorum quales fuerint, I.671.
units.tr: Tsitsith [ציצית], the fringe of the garments of the Hebrews: what were they like? I.671.

units.la: קדוש & קדש quid? I.313.a.
units.tr: Qadosh and qodesh [קדוש & קדש]: what do they mean? I.313.a.

units.la: קהל qualem conventum notet, I.709.a. II.505.a.
units.tr: Qahal: what kind of assembly does it denote? I.709.a. II.505.a.

units.la: קטורות qualia suffimenta fuerint, I.653.b.
units.tr: Qetoroth: what kind of incense offerings were they? I.653.b.

units.la: קראי וכתיב non sunt notæ corrupti textus, I.36.a, quid significet, I.651.b. iniquum, I.571.a.
units.tr: Qere and Kethib are not marks of a corrupt text: I.36.a. What they signify: I.651.b. Whether it is unjust: I.571.a.

units.la: קרבן quid significet, I.651.b. iniquum, I.571.a.
units.tr: Qorban: what it signifies: I.651.b. Whether it is unjust: I.571.a.

units.la: רע quem proximum notet, I.504.a.
units.tr: Ra': which neighbour does it denote? I.504.a.

units.la: רקיע seu Expansum quid? I.203.a.
units.tr: Raqia', or the Expanse: what is it? I.203.a.

units.la: שאול an infernum semper notet? II.52.a.
units.tr: Sheol: does it always denote hell? II.52.a.

units.la: שבט & tribum & virgam notat, I.433.b.
units.tr: Shebet denotes both tribe and rod: I.433.b.

units.la: שרי quale Dei nomen sit, I.69.b.
units.tr: Shaddai: what kind of name of God is it? I.69.b.

units.la: שילה Schilo Messiam notat, I.434.b. ejus vaticinium quando impletum? ib.b. vide Jacob.
units.tr: Shiloh denotes the Messiah: I.434.b. When was his prophecy fulfilled? ibid., b. See Jacob.

units.la: שמים cur Cœli ita dicti? I.205. b.
units.tr: Shamayim: why are the heavens so called? I.205.b.

units.la: שמע oralem ex auditu traditionem, non scripto traditum notat, II.92.a.
units.tr: Shema' denotes an oral tradition handed down by hearing, not one transmitted in writing: II.92.a.

units.la: שמתא Schamatha quale excommunicationis genus? I.589 b. 714.a.
units.tr: Shammatha: what kind of excommunication is it? I.589.b. 714.a.

units.la: שפטים Judices qui & quales fuerint? I.704.b.
units.tr: Shophetim, Judges: who were they and what were they like? I.704.b.

units.la: שרץ & רמש quomodo differant? I.212.b.
units.tr: Sheretz and remesh: how do they differ? I.212.b.

units.la: תהו ובהו Mosis quid fuerit, I.199.b.201.b.206.b.
units.tr: Tohu wabohu: what did Moses mean by it? I.199.b. 201.b. 206.b.

units.la: תפילים seu phylacteria Hebræorum quid sint? I. 671. a.
units.tr: Tephillin, or the phylacteries of the Hebrews: what are they? I.671.a.

units.la: תמונה similitudo, quomodo à פסל differat? I. 532, b. 533. a.
units.tr: Temunah, likeness: how does it differ from pesel? I.532.b. 533.a.
